default.description: No secrets, no cluster access; internet, DNS and pi-sync only.

operator.description: Infra only: cluster-admin, ghcr + platform secrets via operator-env (mise run selfhost:platform:pi-ez-operator:env:apply), open egress.

labrat.description: labrat only: an OpenShell sandbox with Claude through the gateway and read-only cluster access through the labrat-kube relay. No GitHub, no secrets, no other network.
